caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical arrangement dominated by a classical column capital at the center, which is elaborately decorated with scrolls and floral patterns in shades of green, red, pink, gold, and black. At the top of the capital, there is a basket-like vessel filled with various flowers and fruits, primarily rendered in red, pink, and green hues, alongside touches of blue and yellow. Radiating around the central motif are several woven baskets, each filled with flowers and fruit, and surrounded by leafy garlands; the baskets are decorated with a yellow and orange crosshatch pattern and filled with red and pink flowers, green leaves, and some blue accents. The background is light beige with a dotted texture and scattered floral motifs in similar colors. The entire composition is vividly colored, and the objects are densely clustered, creating a richly detailed design with a sense of repetition and order.
title: Printed Cotton
